description: Aaron Flores and colleagues publish property-level flood attributes linked to historical Home Owners’ Loan Corporation grades in the United States. Two freely downloadable CSV files under CC BY 4.0 describe roughly 10.8 million records for 100-year and 500-year scenarios. The README identifies 2020 flood estimates from First Street Foundation’s March 2021 release, RCP4.5 median assumptions and 2010 census-tract geography. Flood depth is in centimetres. These tables can support simulations of unequal exposure across neighbourhoods. They omit property identifiers, addresses and coordinates, so users cannot reliably join individual properties between files; coastal indicators are tract-level values applied to buildings. Missingness differs by scenario, and analytic row counts are lower than raw counts. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this deposit. Files were not downloaded, and prediction uncertainty was not independently assessed.
